self_repairs.issue: Cheer independent head lift exposed a 2-row neck gap.
self_repairs.fix: Use whole-body hop; keep original head attached to the collar. No hidden anatomy drawn.

self_repairs.issue: Initial low celebration arm looked more like a flat sideways indication.
self_repairs.fix: Raised existing near upper arm 58 degrees and source forearm 70 degrees; retained source overlap at shoulder/elbow.

self_repairs.issue: Independent per-action runtime crop/palette could pop scale, origin and clothing colors at facing switches.
self_repairs.fix: One shared crop/scale/palette for every 48px idle/walk/sad/turn; four 6-frame registered facing-source turns with exact endpoint reuse.

known_visual_limits: Turn midposes are registered source dissolves, not newly drawn 3D yaw angles; slight full-size blending remains.
Sad uses a head/shoulder slump and withdrawn arms with the original neutral face; no new frown was invented.
Cheer is a near-arm celebration and small hop. The satchel-occluded far arm remains restrained.
Welcome preserves the original neutral mouth; voice is synchronized narration, not phoneme lip sync.
64-color large deliverables posterize smooth source shading. Lossless masters and true final-size previews preserve the comparison.
review_boundary: Technical gates and self-repair evidence do not claim user or on-device animation acceptance.
